Stated Claim / Post Context:
Club TWiT | Ad Free Tech Podcasts | Members Only Podcast Subscription | TWiT | TWiT.TV

Get all TWiT on demand podcasts ad-free, plus exclusive content and access to the members-only Discord. Join today!

Actual Article Body:
Mikah Sargent has created three video tutorials which demonstrate how to sign up to Club TWiT, subscribe to shows, and access the Club TWiT Discord server. If you need help, these videos are an excellent guide:

Club TWiT Memberships

Join Club TWiT Monthly

Gift Club TWiT (1 Month)

Join Club TWiT Annually

Gift Club TWiT (1 Year)

Club TWiT offers group plans for families and corporations. It's a great way to give your family or your colleagues access to our ad-free tech podcasts. The TWiT Family Plan starts with just two members at a discounted rate of $9/month each and you can add up to ten family members for the same low rate. The TWiT Corporate Plan starts with five members at a discounted rate of $9/month each and you may add as many as you'd like. This is a great way for your IT department, developers, and tech teams to stay up to date with access to all of our podcasts. Just like regular memberships, family or corporate members can each access ad-free feeds of all shows, the TWiT+ bonus feeds, and join the TWiT Discord server.

TWiT is also offering a single-show plans that allows subscribers to access ad-free audio and video versions of TWiT's on-demand podcasts for just $5/month each. They do not include access to the Club TWiT Discord, TWiT+ bonus feeds, or ad-free versions of any other shows.

Single-Show Plans

Not sure if a full Club TWiT membership, single-show plan, or a family plan is right for you? Compare our plans to find the one that best meets your needs.

If your situation changes, you're free to cancel at any time by simply turning off your auto-renew. You don't need to jump through hoops. Read our FAQ for additional details and contact us if you need further assistance.
